name: Butterfly chart (horizontal)
purpose: Two-series comparison per category as mirrored horizontal bars flowing outward from a shared centre gutter — e.g. this-year versus last-year, actual versus target, inflow versus outflow. Semantic SVG in the DOM, styled by tokens, animated by CSS, behaviour by the ONE generated dv-behaviour partial (ADR-0015, worker fence — markers empty). CHART-EXPANSION WAVE 2 lane 1 (2026-08-05); ported from Chart-bar.reference.html's mark contract and Chart-line.reference.html's Layer-2 state model.

props.name: series
props.$note: Exactly two series, one per direction. LEFT takes data/series/1 (categorical default); RIGHT takes data/series/3 (DV-D09's h-bar default, cited here for the positive-reading direction).

props.name: data
props.$note: A real <table class="dv-table"> inside the figure — the a11y spine AND the tabular alternative (dv-005), surfaced by the same TABLE-VIEW POPOVER Chart-bar uses.

props.name: empty
props.$note: No-data state consumes the Empty-state pattern by reference.

variants.name: mirrored horizontal, two series
variants.use: Compare two measures per category, both readable at a glance without stacking or grouping side-by-side.

tokens.font-family: type composites via markup class (DV-D08): .t-cm-chart-label / .t-cm-chart-value = 12/500 · table .t-cm-legal 12/400 · title .t-cm-section-label
tokens.series: LEFT = data/series/1, RIGHT = data/series/3 (DV-D09 cite — orientation-appropriate default reused for the positive-reading direction); high-contrast remap data/series-1-hc / data/series-3-hc (data-contrast="high")
tokens.axis: DECLARED GAP (ds-020, DIVVY-instructed): Chart-bar's DV-D07 two-channel axis/grid CSS role is NOT ported. The two baselines carry colour via inline stroke="var(--baseline)" only, no CSS-side alpha role layered on top, no gridlines drawn at all.
tokens.elevation: table popover + value tip = surface ground + elevation/functional shadow + elevation/border (anchored-overlay recipe, same as Chart-bar)
tokens.$survey: Geometry hand-derived from Chart-bar's column/bar plotting math (two independent baselines either side of a 90px label gutter); Layer-2 machinery (fit/tip/CSV/table-toggle) ported by REFERENCE, not yet injected — AUTO-BEHAVIOUR markers are empty (worker fence).

motion.entry: Bars grow outward from their own baseline (scaleX, transform-box:fill-box) — LEFT grows from its right edge (data-grow="left"), RIGHT grows from its left edge (data-grow="right"), 760ms cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1), 45ms per-row stagger, CSS only (DEF-003).
motion.hover: brightness(1.12) light / (1.22) dark on the bar; legend hover/focus fades the other active series 24%, peeks a ghosted one at 24% (DV-D11, once dv-legend.js is wired).
motion.reducedMotion: Entry inside prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference; global collapse present.

responsive.rule: DV-D02: compress width, never scale text. data-pl="60" data-pr="60" reserves symmetric margins either side of the 460px plot area so both directions have equal room; data-fx/data-fw on rects, data-fx on the two baselines and category labels — same responsive-fit contract as Chart-bar, values recomputed for this file's own geometry.

mustNotNeighbour: A Stat-card making the identical claim in the same view
commonPatterns: this year vs last year by line of business

accessibility.role: figure role="group" + aria-labelledby → sr-only figcaption; svg role="group" with a full-sentence data aria-label reading both series per category.
accessibility.name: The figcaption names the chart; each bar carries aria-label + data-tip naming its category, series and value (popover value == table value, one source).
accessibility.keyboard: Bars are focus stops (tabindex 0 + aria-label → value popover on focus, once dv-behaviour is wired); legend rows are filter buttons (aria-pressed; Shift+Enter isolates, once dv-legend is wired); table toggle = dropdown (aria-controls/expanded, Esc dismiss → refocus).
accessibility.nonText: Both series fills ≥3:1 vs the page both modes (dv-016). DIRECTION (left/right) plus colour disambiguate the two series — on-chart letter keys (bar's .dv-barkey) are deliberately OMITTED here since a third channel is redundant with direction; receipted as a delta from the bar contract, not an oversight.

antiPatterns: More than two series (the mirrored-gutter geometry only reads for a pair; use grouped/stacked bar instead)
Negative values inside either series (dv-bar-007-style — the mirror direction already encodes the second series, a negative value inside one direction is ambiguous)
Raw hex series fills (dv-017 — var() tokens only)
A chart without its real data table (dv-005)
Scaling the whole SVG down responsively (DV-D02 — text must never scale)
